description: This file defines functions for creating and managing dynamic agents for Feishu users, including directory setup and configuration updates.

methods.name: maybeCreateDynamicAgent
methods.description: Creates a new dynamic agent for a Feishu user if not already bound, respecting max agent limits, and updates configuration accordingly.

methods.name: resolveUserPath
methods.description: Resolves a path starting with ~ to the user's home directory.
